notes.title: Bionic Slammer – Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It’s been a while since we last shared any news, and we wanted to reassure you: [i]Bionic Slammer[/i] is still in development! We are a very small team of three people (including one musician), and the project is progressing at its own pace. This is not a full-time development, as we sometimes need to focus on other projects to make a living. Right now, only one person is actively working on the game, and we will release it when it’s ready. We apologize for the silence and truly appreciate your patience.

If you’d like to stay updated, we encourage you to [b]add the game to your Steam wishlist[/b]. We are no longer on X/Twitter and are not very active online, so this is the best way to receive updates and be notified when we have important news to share.

At the end of 2024, we released a [b]playable demo[/b] of [i]Bionic Slammer[/i] on [b][url=https://the-icehouse.itch.io/bionic-slammer]itch.io[/url][/b]. While this demo is based on an early prototype and may still contain issues, it already gives a good idea of what the game will be like. You can try it right now by either downloading the Windows version or playing the HTML version directly on the itch.io page.

We may release the demo (or a different one) on Steam in the future when we have something new to showcase. In the meantime, [b]your feedback on the itch.io demo is incredibly valuable[/b]! Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments to let us know if you’d like to play a full game based on this experience.

A huge thank you to everyone following our progress and to those who have added [i]Bionic Slammer[/i] to their Steam wishlist. Your support means a lot to us! If you enjoy the project, please spread the word and share it on your networks—it really helps us!

See you soon for more updates!

[i]The Bionic Slammer Team[/i]
